doctors.summary: Dr. Anil Kumar Anand is a highly accomplished radiation oncologist with over 31 years of rich experience in the field of radiation oncology. Serving as Principal Director and Head of Department of Radiation Oncology at Fortis Gurgaon, he brings exceptional expertise in the treatment of a wide range of cancers using advanced radiation therapy techniques. His extensive career reflects a deep commitment to delivering precise, evidence-based cancer care to patients from across the globe. Dr. Anand is an alumnus of Dayanand Medical College, Ludhiana, where he completed his MBBS, followed by an MD in Radiotherapy and Oncology from the prestigious Post Graduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGI), Chandigarh. He further honed his skills through specialised training in radiation therapy at the New York Hospital Medical Centre of Queens and in radiotherapy of head and neck cancers at The Middlesex Hospital Medical School, London. His international training and vast clinical experience make him a trusted choice for patients seeking world-class radiation oncology care. A prolific contributor to the medical community, Dr. Anand has numerous scientific publications to his credit, with particular focus on Stereotactic Body Radiation Therapy (SBRT) in recurrent head and neck cancers. He is a member of the Indian Society of Oncology, the American Society of Radiation Oncology, and the Association of Radiation Oncologists of India. He also serves as an Advisor to scientific bodies like ICRO, WHO, and other UN organisations, and is a member of the Editorial Board of the Journal of Cancer Research and Therapeutics.

doctors.name: Dr. D. Shiva Prasad
doctors.summary: Dr. D. Shiva Prasad is a highly skilled Consultant Radiation Oncologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Secunderabad, India. He specializes in delivering high-precision radiotherapy using advanced techniques such as Intensity-Modulated Radiation Therapy (IMRT), Image-Guided Radiation Therapy (IGRT), Stereotactic Radiosurgery (SRS), and Stereotactic Body Radiation Therapy (SBRT). International patients can trust his expertise and commitment to evidence-based, patient-centered oncology care.

doctors.name: Dr. Debnarayan Dutta
doctors.designation: Senior Consultant Radiation Oncologist and Clinical Director, Radiation Oncology
doctors.summary: Dr. Debnarayan Dutta is a distinguished Senior Consultant Radiation Oncologist and Clinical Director at Yashoda Hospitals, Hitec City, Hyderabad. With a career spanning over 19 years, Dr. Dutta has amassed extensive experience and expertise in the treatment of cancer through radiation therapy, particularly specializing in advanced techniques such as CyberKnife and stereotactic radiosurgery. His focus areas of specialization include neurooncology, radiosurgery, and head and neck cancer. Dr. Dutta is a prolific researcher and academician with more than 150 indexed publications, three book chapters, and serves as a reviewer and co-editor of multiple journals. He is also the author of four books. His PhD research focused on the molecular profiling of Indian head and neck cancer patients treated with radical intent image-guided radiation therapy. He has been an invited speaker about CyberKnife/radiosurgery and radiation oncology at more than 250 meetings in India and abroad, reflecting his stature as a thought leader in the field. Dr. Dutta played a pioneering role in introducing the CyberKnife Radiosurgery facility in India in 2010 at Apollo Speciality Cancer Hospital, Chennai. He currently oversees the CyberKnife radiosurgery facility at Yashoda Hospitals and has previously managed the facility at Amrita Institute, Kochi, where he treated more than 1,500 patients with radiosurgery. International patients can trust Dr. Dutta's vast clinical expertise and commitment to delivering cutting-edge cancer care.

doctors.summary: Dr. Azmi Saundarya K is a dedicated Radiation Oncologist with over 8 years of clinical experience, currently serving as Clinical Lead & Consultant in Radiation Oncology at Gleneagles Hospital, Chennai. With comprehensive training spanning an MBBS, Diploma in Medical Radiotherapy (DMRT), Diplomate of National Board in Radiation Oncology (DNB-RT), and a Global Fellowship in Palliative Medicine, she brings a well-rounded approach to cancer care that encompasses both curative treatment and compassionate palliative support. doctors.name: Dr. Pradeep Kumar Karumanchi

With extensive training at prestigious institutions in India and abroad — including Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSKCC) in New York, the University of Michigan, the University of Geneva in Switzerland, and Accuray (USA) — he brings a rare combination of international expertise and clinical excellence to cancer care. Nalini is a highly experienced Senior Consultant Radiation Oncologist at Yashoda Hospitals, Somajiguda, Hyderabad, with over 31 years of dedicated experience in the field of radiation oncology. She holds advanced training from internationally renowned institutions, including MD Anderson Cancer Center in Houston, USA, and The Royal Marsden Hospital in London, making her one of the most accomplished radiation oncologists in the region. Dr. Nalini brings deep expertise in the management of solid tumors using advanced radiation techniques, including intensity modulated radiation therapy (IMRT), image-guided radiation therapy (IGRT), stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS), and stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT). Her special interests include gastrointestinal cancers, breast cancers, head and neck cancers, gynecological cancers, brain tumors, and pediatric cancers. She is also proficient in brachytherapy, including intracavitary and image-guided techniques, offering comprehensive cancer care to patients from India and abroad. As a clinician-researcher, Dr. Nalini has served as a trial investigator and co-investigator in several landmark international clinical trials, including the ToGA Study and the ATLAS Breast Cancer Treatment Trial, reflecting her commitment to evidence-based oncology practice. Her memberships in prestigious organizations such as the American Society for Therapeutic Radiology and Oncology (ASTRO) and the Union for International Cancer Congress (UICC) further underscore her standing in the global oncology community.
